alt: Poster: Markets rebound after holiday: Sensex above 83,900 (up over 1.8%), Nifty 50 above 25,790 (up over 1.7%), Nifty Media down over 4%, 25 Nov 2026
text:
Indian benchmarks rebounded sharply on Wednesday after the Guru Nanak Jayanti market holiday.

• Per Kotak Neo, InCred Money and IndustryWired closing reports, the Sensex closed above 83,900 and the Nifty 50 above 25,790, gains of more than 1.8% and 1.7% respectively from Monday's closes (Sensex 82,435.99, Nifty 25,349.65).
• Nifty Bank rose roughly 1.8% to 2.3% across the three reports, with private banks and financials among the leaders.
• Nifty Metal fell and Nifty Media dropped more than 4%; Nifty Smallcap 100 ended lower in all three reports.
• Reports cited buying in large caps, foreign institutional investor buying and lower crude. Exact closing levels differ slightly between reports, so we quote only figures common to all three.

Our view: a rally led by large banks and financials, while smallcaps slip, suggests the move was narrow in character. One session after a holiday is a thin sample, so we read this as rotation within the market rather than a change of trend. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: when large caps rebound but smallcaps do not follow, how do you explain the difference to clients holding diversified portfolios?
